title: OST background-music reference catalog
description: Metadata only. Audio is copyrighted, never shipped or streamed by the public app. Checked by tests/test_ost_catalog.py.

id.description: <work>-<disc>-<track>; x = no track number, r = replacement of an earlier upload by the official release

superseded_by.description: Set when this upload (a cover or someone else's re-upload) was replaced by the official release with that id; the entry stays as a record and is excluded.

excluded_reason.description: Set when the track was reviewed but cannot sit under narration (sung lyrics, wrong length...).

description.description: 2-4 Vietnamese sentences in our own words: sound, feeling, fitting scenes, why it is liked.

list_votes.description: How many independent external lists (rankings, polls, forum threads, playlists) name this track; 0 = none of the lists gathered so far. The list URLs stay in the private catalog.

instrumental_of.description: Set on the official instrumental / off-vocal release of a sung song: the title of the sung original, which itself is recorded with vocals=true and kept out of narration.

version.description: official = release (Topic) or composer/publisher channel; reupload = someone else's upload of the soundtrack track; cover = arrangement/performance by someone else; processed = 3D/spatial re-processing; unverified = not settled.
